comment: Layers (CLAUDE.md rule 5). A folder in `pure` may not import any module in `banned`, nor a folder in `renderFolders`. `banEverywhere` lists text that no file under src may contain. `owners`: a field of the game's state and the one file that may change it ({ field, owner, what }); every field of simulation state gets a row when it is made (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

banEverywhere.why: every random number comes from a seed (@futuremagic/core Rng)

owners.what: the seed of a match's wind swings and gusts
a match's wind force on the Beaufort scale
the mean bearing a match's wind blows from
